✓ Udaipur House.fact: It formerly served as the city residence of the Maharanas of Udaipur and is one of the remaining examples of the architectural presence of the princely states in India's capital. Udaipur House was constructed for the Maharanas of Mewar for this purpose.

✓ Udaipur House.question: Although smaller than _____ or Jaipur House, it contains notable features such as a central hall, landscaped lawns, and elements resembling traditional Rajasthani architecture
✓ Udaipur House.fact: Although smaller than Hyderabad House or Jaipur House, it contains notable features such as a central hall, landscaped lawns, and elements resembling traditional Rajasthani architecture.
